fluff.overview:
The Lao Hu was introduced in 3062 as a product of Chancellor Sun-Tzu Liao's Xin Sheng revitalization program. Designed by a student at the Victoria Academy of Arms and Technology, the seventy-five-ton heavy 'Mech was conceived as an evolution of the Thunder BattleMech, correcting perceived shortcomings in that design through the application of new technologies made available by the Capellan Confederation's growing industrial capacity. The name Lao Hu, meaning "Tiger" in Chinese, proved prophetic as the design lived up to its aggressive namesake on the battlefield.

Manufactured by Shengli Arms on Victoria, the Lao Hu was developed to bridge the gap between heavy and assault-class BattleMechs, offering the firepower to hold its own against heavier opponents while maintaining respectable mobility. The design quickly became one of the most popular heavy 'Mechs in the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces.
fluff.capabilities:
The Lao Hu is built on a Chariot Type II Endo Steel chassis and powered by a GM 375 XL engine, achieving a top speed of eighty-six kilometers per hour. This impressive speed for a seventy-five-ton design comes at the cost of engine survivability, as the extralight powerplant is vulnerable to torso damage, but the trade-off frees tonnage for a formidable weapons payload and thirteen and a half tons of Star Shell Standard armor protection.

The design's primary striking power comes from its Shengli LB 20-X autocannon, the same weapon fitted to the Yu Huang assault 'Mech. Capable of firing both standard slugs and cluster munitions, the autocannon gives the Lao Hu devastating close-range firepower with enough ammunition to sustain extended engagements against multiple assault-class opponents. A Martell extended-range large laser and Zeus LRM-15 launcher complement the autocannon, providing effective fire support at longer ranges while the varied LRM munitions developed for the Confederation further augment the design's tactical flexibility.

This combination of speed, firepower, and protection creates a 'Mech designed for aggressive engagement at medium to close range, closing quickly to bring its devastating autocannon to bear while energy weapons and missiles soften targets during the approach.
fluff.history:
The Lao Hu emerged from Shengli Arms' production facility on Victoria in 3062, one of several new designs developed as part of the Capellan Confederation's Xin Sheng national revitalization movement. The facility, built around a rediscovered Star League-era research complex and restored with discreet assistance from the Word of Blake, had already produced the Duan Gung, Jinggau, and Yu Huang before the Lao Hu joined its production lines.

The design first saw combat during the St. Ives conflict, where its role was initially underestimated. The Lao Hu's true value became apparent through numerous successful petitions from assault-class lances and independent companies requesting the design, and by its seventh production run the Lao Hu had surpassed the Jinggau in popularity among Capellan commanders. Few regiments in the Confederation did not boast at least one of these machines.

The onset of the Jihad brought both opportunity and disaster for the Lao Hu program. In December 3068, Olson's Rangers, mercenaries garrisoning the Shengli Arms facility, turned their weapons against the very factory they were hired to protect, inflicting devastating damage that crippled production lines. While Shengli Arms eventually recovered partial production capacity, the facility suffered capital and personnel losses of eighty-four percent from this single attack. The Jihad-era LHU-3L variant initially appeared as a field refit before entering limited factory production.

The Victoria War proved catastrophic for the Lao Hu's original production line. When the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns invaded Victoria in 3103, retreating Capellan forces destroyed the Shengli Arms facility rather than allow it to fall into enemy hands. Ceres Metals Industries on Sian, leveraging their partial ownership of the Lao Hu design, subsequently took over production by phasing out their Thunder manufacturing lines to accommodate the more popular design. This ensured continued availability of the Lao Hu and its variants even as Victoria changed hands between the Federated Suns and Capellan Confederation.

When the CCAF recaptured Victoria in 3145 during Operation CELESTIAL REWARD, the planet's industrial infrastructure had been fundamentally altered by decades of Davion occupation and Lao Hu production remained centered at the Ceres Metals facility on Sian.
fluff.deployment: This variant is the original production model that entered service in 3062, pairing the devastating Shengli LB 20-X autocannon with a Zeus LRM-15 launcher and Martell extended-range large laser. This combination provides effective firepower at all engagement ranges, with the autocannon's dual ammunition capability allowing MechWarriors to switch between armor-piercing slugs and cluster rounds as tactical conditions demand. The design quickly proved popular with Capellan commanders, and the 2B remained the standard production variant throughout the initial years of the Lao Hu program.
